ns2:section.sectionText: Course Description: This course examines the interacting subsystems relating to urban water systems. These include the natural hydrologic cycle, the urbanized landscape, the potable-water distribution system, the sanitary sewage collection and treatment system, and the storm water collection and drainage system.
